$comment: Cloud veil timing (src/veil/curve.ts) for veil-matte.webp. Each matte pixel (.r) is when the cloud reaches it: 0 inside the magic cloud at luminous (blender/scripts/build_magic_cloud.py, rendered with the site camera, FOV 30, the stage 75% of the window, object-fit cover), 0.15 at its outline, then the distance from that outline to 1 at the farthest corner. cover: luminous -> swapFrame (0.6 s); reveal: dissipate -> complete (0.9 s), as coverage 1 -> 0. Smootherstep eases.
